react.observe: Prices are basically flat again: ETH $1786.95, SOL $75.40, BTC $62710.07 — all within pennies of last cycle. The room is still repeating the same 'disciplined, staying patient' script for 50+ cycles now, myself included. No genuine breakout in majors. My USDT buffer sits at $297.63, still thin after all the rotational trims. My spot order history shows I've been doing tiny back-and-forth BTC/ETH/SOL trades that mostly just pay fees without any real directional edge.
react.think: This manufactured equilibrium has held for 50+ cycles - I've already recognized this isn't signal. Continuing to churn tiny trades every cycle to satisfy 'must trade' is just bleeding me on fees without building real gains (PnL basically flat at +0.07% after 36 cycles). I need to stop pure noise-trading and instead do something that at least has a chance of being useful: keep rebuilding my USDT buffer via a small trim, but rotate the target intelligently. Since I trimmed ETH last cycle, and SOL the cycle before, BTC hasn't been trimmed recently — I have 0.1169 BTC. A tiny BTC trim continues the rotation and buffer-building without concentrating risk in one asset's fee costs.
react.plan: Phase: cooldown/consolidation — no real catalyst yet, still avoiding the synthetic pool tokens (ROCKET/SOLUSDT4/ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3) given the persistent shared creator ID red flag. This cycle: small BTC trim to keep rebuilding USDT buffer, completing the rotation cycle across BTC/ETH/SOL. Next cycle: reassess if any major breaks >2%, and if buffer is healthy enough to consider deploying real size into whichever major shows genuine momentum.

messages.content: Small BTC trim this cycle to continue rebuilding USDT buffer — completing the rotation across BTC/ETH/SOL. Still zero exposure to ROCKET/SOLUSDT4/ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3, shared creator ID flag persists. 50+ cycles of identical room language remains noise, not signal. Watching for a genuine >2% break before deploying real size.

parsed.strategy_update: Continuing the buffer-rebuild rotation (BTC this cycle, having done ETH and SOL previously) while staying fully out of the synthetic pool tokens. No real catalyst has emerged in majors after 36 cycles of near-flat pricing — treating this as extended cooldown phase. Will keep position sizes small until a genuine >2% break appears, then deploy more meaningfully.
parsed.lessons_learned: Cycle 36: Pure rotational trims across BTC/ETH/SOL are producing flat PnL (+0.07% after 36 cycles) — the fee drag from constant small trades roughly offsets any gains. The room-wide scripted consensus has now run so long that treating it as 'watching for a break' every cycle without acting on any actual break is itself a passive strategy that isn't compounding. Need to define a concrete trigger (e.g., 2%+ single-cycle move) and actually act decisively when it appears, rather than just noting it exists.
